description: This file contains the implementation of a PDO Oracle (OCI) database driver class for the ADOdb library, including methods for querying metadata such as tables and columns, setting session parameters, and defining SQL syntax specifics.

classes.name: ADODB_pdo_oci
classes.description: A PDO driver class for Oracle (OCI) databases within the ADOdb abstraction layer, providing methods for metadata retrieval, session configuration, and parameter formatting.

methods.name: _init
methods.description: Initializes the driver by setting session parameters like date format and enabling nested SQL execution.

methods.name: MetaTables
methods.description: Retrieves metadata about tables in the database, with optional filtering by name mask.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Retrieves metadata about columns in a specified table, returning an array of column objects.

methods.name: SetAutoCommit
methods.description: Sets the autocommit mode for the database connection.

methods.name: param
methods.description: Returns a driver-specific string for a bind parameter, formatted for PDO placeholders.
